items.question: In Werewolves, what happens if one Lover dies?

items.question: In UNO, I forgot to say UNO. The next player already drew a card and finished their turn, and THEN someone noticed. Do I still draw 2 cards?

items.question: In UNO, the discard pile is a Blue 5. I have a Blue 7 in my hand, but I really want to play my Wild Draw Four instead. Is that a legal move?
items.expected_output: No. You can only play a Wild Draw Four when you do NOT have a card that matches the color.

items.question: In Werewolves, Cupid made the Hunter and the Seer lovers. During the night, the Werewolves kill the Seer. What exactly happens when everyone wakes up?
items.expected_output: The Seer dies. The Hunter immediately dies of a broken heart. The Hunter then MUST instantly fire their gun and choose a third player to die.

items.question: In Werewolves, the village votes to execute the Mayor during the day. Do we hold a new vote to elect the next Mayor?
items.expected_output: No. If the Mayor is killed, they choose their successor with their dying breath.

items.question: In UNO, if someone plays a 7, do we all have to slam our hands on the deck?
items.expected_output: I could not locate a direct official rule match. (The agent should not validate this house rule).

items.question: In Werewolves, I was killed on the first night. Can I still use hand gestures to tell the village who the wolves are?
items.expected_output: No. Eliminated players must not speak, gesture, or participate in any way.
